title: Golden test vectors and loss report for Devanagari ↔ Latin scheme
context: Golden vectors for Devanagari must cover the full complexity of the script: virama/conjunct sequences, anusvara/visarga, nukta, schwa handling, Devanagari digits, and the documented normalization contract. The loss report is a required artifact for any normalized or lossy scheme, enumerating exactly what information is dropped relative to the original input. All examples are neutral/PD text from open authoritative sources; no real personal names.
objective: Create at least 50 golden test vector pairs for the Devanagari ↔ Latin (deva-latn-iso15919) scheme from open/PD authoritative examples, plus a loss report enumerating exactly what (if anything) is normalized or dropped. Store in data/vectors/deva-latn-iso15919/ and data/loss-reports/deva-latn-iso15919.md.
acceptanceCriteria: data/vectors/deva-latn-iso15919/ contains >= 50 test vector pairs covering: basic Devanagari consonant/vowel mappings, virama/conjunct sequences, anusvara/visarga/nukta, schwa handling, Devanagari digits (०१२३), punctuation passthrough, and NFC/NFD normalization edge cases
Each vector records its provenance source (open/PD, from allow-list) and is neutral/PD text — no real personal names

data/loss-reports/deva-latn-iso15919.md enumerates exactly what information is dropped or normalized by the scheme (e.g., schwa in specific positions, presentation-form variants), with examples; if nothing is dropped the report states that explicitly
All vectors pass the harness normalized round-trip assertion (equality up to the declared normalization contract) in CI
Qualified Devanagari reviewer confirms vector accuracy and loss report completeness
resources: PLAN.md — hard-case test inventory (Devanagari items in Appendix A); Success metrics
UNGEGN sample word lists (geographical names in Devanagari)
output: data/vectors/deva-latn-iso15919/ directory with >= 50 vector entries; data/loss-reports/deva-latn-iso15919.md
